heading: Today
text: Mostly cloudy, with a few stray showers north, mostly through the higher terrain.  Some intervals of sun south, with a localized, passing afternoon shower.  Highs in the 50s north, 60s south.  Winds light, becoming northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph late.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds, and a few mountain showers north. Becoming partly cloudy in southern valleys.  Breezy and cooler.  Lows in the 30s to low 40s.  Winds from the northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.

heading: Thursday
text: Some morning clouds, especially north, giving way to increasing sunshine, and becoming mostly sunny south. Chilly. Highs from 50 to 60 north to south.  Northwest winds 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph early, diminishing from the north to less than 10 mph in the afternoon.
